text:
alex: Thanks for joining today's all-hands. Starting a follow-up thread to collect clarifications, links, and owners for action items.

rachel: Quick clarification on Dedicated GA timing: target mid-Oct. Feature freeze 2026-09-10, compliance sign-off 2026-09-30, GA 2026-10-15. I'll upload the timeline RFC.

mia: Re: 32k context performance 1. Who's leading the tuning effort?

dan: I'll take runtime ownership. Dan -> INF-3281 created for coordination.
tyler: I'll push the rollout checklist to the product repo today and share the PR link here when ready.

olivia: We should add a plain-language FAQ about model pinning vs automatic routing for the sales kit. I can draft.
sam: Pricing example in the deck hid burst costs. Can product+finance provide worked examples (50 RPS app, 2k RPS app)?
rachel: Yep. Finance will prep those. Sam, please drop your demo app profile into INF-3410.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Recording and slides -> https://redwood.example.com/ah/2026-03-23

mia: Summary of action items:
- Dedicated GA timeline: rachel (owner) - due 2026-09-30
- Rollout checklist PR: tyler - due today EOD
- 32k tuning RFC: dan + mia - create INF-3281 - due 2026-04-06
- Model pinning FAQ: olivia draft + tyler review - due 2026-03-30
- Pricing worked examples: rachel + finance - due 2026-04-13
- Canary guide for customers: alex + eng-sre - draft due 2026-04-06

alex: Also: please file short "AH-ask" cards on the roadmap board for any feature requests heard today (2-3 lines, customer + impact). I'll create a template.

tyler: Will create the roadmap card template and broadcast to channels.

olivia: Security Q: will HSM be available at GA for Private deployments?
rachel: Not at GA. GA supports cloud KMS (AWS/GCP). HSM targeted for Private beta post-GA.
dan: Reminder: kernel optimization spike tomorrow 10am to test a new fused attention op. Folks wanting numbers please join.
mia: I'll join.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post a dotfiles doc tomorrow morning with links to RFCs and tickets. If you want to be added to an owner list or a task is missing, reply here.
